## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (65%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability is flagged low [F6]; the set spans three classes.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 65%, Normal 16%, Invasive 12% | Benign leads, not dominant |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, Invasive | Three classes unseparated |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.30 / 76th percentile | Input flagged suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign | Mixed neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term against invasive; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 8, 9, 10) · ↑ invasive · Second-largest term toward invasive; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Associated with invasive carcinoma; spot check 19/20 [F4] · Validated
- **Gland/tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood; spot check 18/20, caption check failed · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Poor image quality (reliability 0.30) makes every probability here unstable.
- Regions 8–11 show high per-region invasive risk, so a focal invasive area may be under-called.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 11:** Look for infiltrating tumor in stroma.
2. **Regions 8, 9:** Check pleomorphism and mitoses directly; the mitosis score failed its spot check.
3. **Regions 1, 2, 3:** Confirm lobules are normal; that concept failed its spot check.
